# Kristi Achilleos

> Fractional CTO and engineering leader based in Cyprus, working internationally. I build products, and the teams behind them. Taking on new projects from December 2026.

## About

- Role: Fractional CTO and engineering leader; hands-on founding engineer.
- Experience: 10+ years across software engineering, engineering management and founding-engineer roles.
- Highlights: led the engineering team behind a product that reached £1M+ ARR (Unibuddy); split a monolith team into autonomous squads, with development velocity up 30% and incidents resolved 40% faster (Playroll); built an AI-native platform from scratch as a founding engineer, serving three hotel-group customers and reliably handling 500K-email sends (Familiar).
- Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, React Native / Expo, AWS, AI agents.
- Location: Cyprus (EET, UTC+2). Remote-first, working with teams across time zones.

## Services

- Fractional CTO (ongoing, part-time): architecture and technology decisions, hiring and team growth, roadmap and trade-offs.
- 0-to-1 product build (fixed scope): backend, web and mobile, with AI features and agents where they earn their place.
- Team and delivery review (short engagement): delivery process, incident response, team structure, with a written assessment and prioritised plan.
